description:
AgentDeck turns Stream Deck and Stream Deck + into a live dashboard for AI coding agents. Follow sessions, see who needs your attention and answer supported requests. It requires the free AgentDeck daemon on the same computer.

See Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Kiro, Antigravity and Hermes activity. Hermes and other observation-only sessions stay read-only. Controls depend on the daemon and integration.

2.0 preserves original choices and distinct session names, separates human Attention from CI waits and improves reconnect behavior. Select a session, answer supported requests, change a supported mode or stop a supported session.

Four dials: system volume, Claude usage, Codex usage and Launcher. Usage follows source-reported windows and reset times. Session keys and usage work on macOS and Windows.

Bundled profiles cover Stream Deck, Mini, XL, + and + XL. The + XL assigns four dials; its two extra dials stay unassigned.

Setup: use the free AgentDeck app from the Mac App Store, or run npx @agentdeck/setup on macOS or Windows. Enable integrations and start agents normally. After updating the native app and CLI together, refresh enabled integrations and review Codex hook trust when prompted.

No analytics. Independent project; all trademarks belong to their owners.
AI-assisted development, icon and copy. Gallery screens use the actual plugin renderers.
releaseNotes: AgentDeck 2.1 shows on the VOICE key whether a dictated prompt was delivered, held or refused by the selected session, and clears that status when the daemon disconnects. Update the AgentDeck daemon/installer too; delivery status needs a 2.1 daemon and a supported agent integration.
